name: zhihu-qa-helper
description: 知乎答主助手 — 垂直领域答主的问题筛选、材料核查与批阅台

scripts.app: npm run build:web && cargo build -p zhihu-qa-core && cargo build -p zhihu-qa-desktop && node scripts/run-app.mjs
scripts.app:release: npm run build:web && cargo build --release -p zhihu-qa-core && cargo build --release -p zhihu-qa-desktop && node scripts/run-app.mjs --release
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:web && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:web && cargo build --release -p zhihu-qa-core && cargo build --release -p zhihu-qa-desktop
